mapper.select:
SELECT 1 AS DAYS, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CODE) AS DAY_COUNT, SUM(DAY_1) AS QTY FROM t_mp_month_plan_production_final WHERE PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DAY_1 > 0
UNION ALL SELECT ${day} AS DAYS, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CODE) AS DAY_COUNT, SUM(DAY_${day}) AS QTY FROM t_mp_month_plan_production_final WHERE PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DAY_${day} > 0

select *, (SELECT t_mdm_material_info.COMMON_TYPE FROM t_mdm_material_info WHERE t_mdm_material_info.PRODUCT_CODE=t_mp_month_plan_production_final.PRODUCT_CODE AND t_mdm_material_info.IS_DELETE='0' LIMIT 1) AS LOCATION_TYPE from t_mp_month_plan_production_final where IS_DELETE = 0
and (YEAR, MONTH, FACTORY_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, SPEC_CODE) in
(#{item.year}, #{item.month}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.productCode}, #{item.specCode})
